items.title: Removal of Hoarding around High School Main Field/Running Track
items.author: Woon Ta Wei David
items.description:
Dear Students,
Some of you may have noticed that the hoardings for the High School running track being removed today.
Please take note that we can only make use of it after today as the contractors are in the process of clearing some debris off the track. Please avoid using the running track and main field until next Monday.
Thank you!
Mr David Woon
SH/PE & CCA (High School Section)
